# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest released version of
`teqneers/phpunit-stopwatch`. Please make sure you are on an up-to-date version
before reporting an issue.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please report security vulnerabilities privately — do **not** open a public
issue. Use GitHub's
[private security advisory](https://github.com/teqneers/phpunit-stopwatch/security/advisories/new)
form, or email <oliver@teqneers.de>.

You will receive an acknowledgement as soon as possible, and we will keep you
informed about the progress towards a fix and a release.
